question: Is there a field-level 6 -> 3 intertwiner from the native boson amplitudes in Lambda^2 4 to the geometric h-space, and with which clock and charge covariance?
summary_de: h-Raum unter <M,U> ist S4 std(x)sgn. Lambda^2 4 = std + std(x)sgn; genau ein clockkovarianter Feldprojektor 6->h (Lambda^2 der Summe-null-Drei), nicht ladungskovariant. Kein 3+1-Split zugleich ladungs- und clockkovariant. Kovariante Zustand->Cartan-Abbildung ist die Impulsabbildung sum|b_w|^2 w (quadratisch), liefert auf Einzelgewicht das Label beta_F. h_geom ist keine lineare native Bosonamplitude.
kills: The rank-3 label map L/S is a linear isometry of the six native boson amplitudes
A 3+1 field projector on Lambda^2 4 is simultaneously charge- and clock-covariant
The geometric one-clock/CP bound applies to native boson fields without a derived field intertwiner
assumptions: Mark permutation action of S4 on the 4 of SU(4)
not_derived: Source selection between the charge-expectation reading and a chosen field projector
Reality condition on the self-dual 6, if used
